# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux desktop environment
- **Application Title Bar**: 
  - Left: "Activities" icon
  - Center: "LibreOffice Writer" application name
  - Right: System clock showing "Oct 22 19:49" and system tray icons (including sound and power)
- **Document Title**: "Ophthalmologist_Prescription.docx - LibreOffice Writer"

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**:
  - Google Chrome icon (browser)
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**:
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu Options**:
  - New
  - Open...
  - Open Remote...
  - Recent Documents
  - Close
  - Wizards
  - Templates
  - Reload
  - Versions...
  - Save
  - Save As...
  - Save Remote...
  - Save a Copy...
  - Save All
  - Export...
  - Export As
  - Send
  - Preview in Web Browser
  - Print Preview (Shift+Ctrl+O)
  - Print... (Ctrl+P)
  - Printer Settings...
  - Properties...
  - Digital Signatures
  - Exit LibreOffice (Ctrl+Q)

## Toolbar

- **Formatting Toolbar**:
  - Font selection dropdown showing "Times New Roman"
  - Font size dropdown showing "20 pt"
  - Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U), Strikethrough (S) buttons
  - Font color and highlight color selectors
  - Alignment buttons (left, center, right, justify)
  - List formatting buttons (bulleted, numbered)
  - Indentation and spacing controls
  - Text direction and special character insertion buttons

## Document Content Area

- **Document Title**: "Ophthalmologist_Prescription.docx"
- **Document Layout**:
  - Header section with "Doctor's Name" and "Specialist in" fields
  - Medical symbol (Caduceus) on the right side of the header
  - Patient information fields: Name, Age, Gender, Date
  - Large blank area for prescription content
  - Signature line at the bottom left
  - Hospital information box at the bottom right with fields for Hospital Name, Address, Line, Street Name, Country, Pin Code

## Status Bar

- **Document Information**:
  - Page 1 of 1
  - 20 words, 169 characters
  - Default Page Style
  - Language: English (USA)
- **Zoom Control**:
  - Zoom slider with current zoom level set to 60%
  - Zoom in/out buttons

## Sidebar

- **Right Sidebar**:
  - "Get involved" button with close (X) icon
  - "Donate" button with close (X) icon
  - Vertical menu icon (three horizontal lines)
  - Application icons for:
    - Document properties
    - Styles
    - Find and replace
    - Page layout
    - Document view options
    - Accessibility tools

## Document View

- **Document Display**:
  - Document is displayed in a single-page view
  - Document is centered on the page
  - Document has a clean, professional layout suitable for medical prescriptions
  - Document is currently in edit mode with no text entered in the fields

## Document Metadata

- **Document Name**: "Ophthalmologist_Prescription.docx"
- **Document Type**: LibreOffice Writer document
- **Document Content**: Prescription template for an ophthalmologist
- **Document Fields**: Doctor's name, patient information, prescription content, signature, hospital information

## Document Structure

- **Document Layout**:
  - Header section with doctor's name and medical symbol
  - Patient information fields
  - Prescription content area
  - Signature line
  - Hospital information box
- **Document Formatting**:
  - Professional medical template
  - Clear, organized layout
  - Ready for customization and printing

## Document Status

- **Document State**: Open and editable
- **Document Progress**: 0% complete (no text entered)
- **Document Purpose**: Medical prescription template for ophthalmologists
